scope: packages/spa, SPA CI/spec/lockfile changes; diagnostic generated files excluded
major_findings: M-002 | Major | packages/spa/src/server/proxy.ts:46 and proxy.test.ts:187 | An oversized decoded response only cancels the reader, while the test labels plain JSON bytes as gzip and therefore exercises no decompression; a compressed oversized response can regress without detection and the required fetch abort is not verified. | Abort the request controller immediately on overflow and test a genuinely gzip-compressed streamed upstream at the limit-1, limit, and limit+1 decoded boundaries, asserting cancellation.
summary: Closure did not pass because the compressed decoded-size and overflow-cancellation coverage was not meaningful. M-001, deadline checks, cancellation, encoded dispatch, HEAD/POST, symlink handling, ASCII token trimming, and O_NOFOLLOW were otherwise accepted.
